findings.remediation: Bind all player controls to the current panel revision and originating channel. Before provider reads and again before replies, reject moved/reconfigured controls and verify current member ViewChannel/ReadMessageHistory permissions using fresh Discord channel/member/role state. Fail closed when authorization cannot be established.

surfaces.notes: All 15 full files read, including entire event-form-panel.tsx 1-3288. New selectors use React text rendering and restricted type filtering; manual ID is a convenience, not authorization. Event fields flow to existing authenticated event handlers, and transport independently binds guild. Strict settings reject unknown keys; effective permission calculations honor overwrites. Membership game overrides do not inherit message IDs; legacy event adoption keeps the old channel.
